title: The Far Out
author: CarloAmares
selftext:
Hi everyone! 👋

I'd like to share a little project I've been working on: **The Far Out**, a retro space trading game that runs right in your browser.

Think 80s neon and synthwave. You start with a small second-hand ship and 1,000 credits, trade goods between star systems, fight pirates (or run from them), mine asteroids, upgrade your ship and hire a crew. There's also a story about a legendary lost ship, the ASTRA NOX, and a few strange secrets hidden out at the Rim.

This is my very first game, so please be gentle 🙂 I'm from Germany, and the game was originally written in German. I only recently translated it into English. English isn't my native language, so if something sounds odd or a joke doesn't quite land, I'd really like to know.

It's an early beta and free to play in your browser. You'll need a computer with keyboard and mouse; phones aren't supported yet.  
👉 [https://dirkster.itch.io/the-far-out](https://dirkster.itch.io/the-far-out)

Id  be very grateful for any feedback: what you liked, what confused you, what annoyed you, bugs, balancing, anything at all. Thank you so much for taking a look!
